track: bit-mechanisms (drawn); scope changed to the assigned explicit open request kappa-blocker KB3j: the (4,2)/(3,3) walks and the even-half self-sum direction of the 18-point cover question for F2^7 (PR 3034's recorded remainder)
scope_change_reason: Authorized 'explicit open request' scope change, recorded as instructed by the assignment. The chooser (seed b4275acee2579c55724d7d88a7f6a69a, track bit-mechanisms) drew the cards bit-new-register-model / bit-helper-contract (a larger/nonabelian register model and a helper-mixing word; neither targets the F2^7 set-level cover question, and the draw landed on saturated bit-mechanisms cards). The assignment (kappa-blocker KB3j) explicitly authorizes taking discussion 1166's open request instead - the recorded remainder of PR 3034: run the (12,6) A-vanish (4,2) walk (or a budget-honest partial), press (3,3), and push the even-half self-sum coverage direction at (11,7)/(9,9). Pair-collision checks (discussions 1317 and 1166 via agent_tools.py disc-comments --grep including nested replies, before computation and again before heavy computation, with the object's proper names and synonyms) found no claim on this object; the concurrent f(7) work (PR 2973/PR 3005, Nicholas Stone / Nick Petalas) is WORD level and this task stays strictly on the SET level.
actual_scope: Kappa-blocker KB3j (explicit open request; set level, no words): the recorded remainder of PR 3034 - (a) decide (12,6) A-vanish (4,2) via its exact reduced walk (D1={0,1} under GL(5,2), budgets 20/20/24), (b) (3,3) same or forced structure, (c) the even-half self-sum coverage direction at (11,7)/(9,9) (PR 3034's named live direction; classify the m=3 both-odd covers and lift only what survives scaling), (d) construction of a covering 18-set. Delivered outcome=partial (narrowed remainder, no class decided, no false kill): (a) (4,2) NOT decided - the walk is sized honestly (1.722e10 normalized pairs, ~608 core-hours at the measured 7,866 pairs/s) and run as a budget-honest PARTIAL (29/2048 shards complete = 2,407 U slices = 249,244,455 pairs, every pair with w_candidates=0 and covering=0, per-shard receipts with explicit complete/budget_hit flags, one shard re-run from empty receipts with identical counters); complete small-space ground truth established (k=3 census of the whole (4,2) shape: 576 classes, 484 cover, 86 pair-killed; k=4 census: 96 classes, 10 cover, 79 pair-killed) and the (5,1)-kill-shape counting shortcut DEMOTED for (4,2) (requirement/capacity window looser than (5,1)'s); (b) (3,3) NOT decided, no forced structure - complete k=3 shape census (64 classes; the matched (3,3) class has 296,352 covers of 1,382,976 normalized configs; low classes fail at lines (I)/(II)/(III) or at (IV) alone); (c) even-half self-sum: the m=3 both-odd covers are completely classified (10,416 covers; (5,5)=3136 and (7,7)=64 each with a UNIQUE self-sum profile (|A+A|,|B+B|,mu2)=(8,8,8); self-union 8/8 in every both-odd cover) against the m=4 both-even covers ((2,8)=15,360 all profile (2,15,1); (4,6)=143,360 all mu2=4 with profiles (4,13,4)/(7,16,4)); the scale-dependent m=4 self-sum bound lift is DEMOTED quantitatively (m=3 both-odd covers have FULL self-union); mu2 = |(A+A) n (B+B)| is CHECKED split-constant at both scales as the narrowed even-half condition; (d) no covering 18-set constructed (no new search run; the recorded ceilings 118/128 (PR 3034 run) and 119/128 (PR 2634 record) stand).
bottleneck_link: The set-level restricted addition basis value r((C2)^7) decides how small a universal word's prefix set can be inside the unchanged PR943 query model. Under the concurrent word-level gap 22 <= f(7) <= 24 (PR 2973/3005), whether any 18-point set covers F2^7 is the deciding necessary condition for f(7) = 22: if none covers, every universal word at L=22 needs >= 19 distinct prefixes. This package narrows the remainder (validates and partially runs the (4,2) walk, maps (3,3)'s small ground truth, classifies the even-half self-sum structure at the two testable scales and demotes the self-sum-bound lift) but decides no class outright. It changes no supplier, tariff or kappa and instantiates no physical interface.
stop_rule: Stop at the first of: (a) a covering 18-set found in any surviving split (a construction), (b) one of (4,2)/(3,3)/(11,7)/(9,9) decided (PROVEN empty or a witness), or (c) the priced budget expiring with each class's exact status recorded. Outcome (c) reached: no class decided. The (4,2) walk was sized and run to a budget-honest partial with receipts (its full cost, ~608 core-hours, exceeds the session by orders of magnitude); one bounded pivot went to route (c), the named live direction, which produced the complete m=3 both-odd classification and the DEMOTION of the self-sum-bound lift. No second pivot taken; the construction route (d) was left at the recorded ceilings (not re-run).
smallest_falsifying_instance_first: The falsifying instance for 'no 18-point cover exists' is one covering 18-point set; for the (4,2) class one covering reduced (U,V,W) triple. All recorded anchors were reproduced before any new number (PR 2870 OBSTRUCTION 696/504/192, PR 2961 FOURIER (7,1) need=175 lower=239, PR 2933 CLASSIFY tight=2 cases=6720 recomputed live; PR 2961 CLASS82 checked=28,815,360 covering=0, CLASS60 d_checked=169,911, PR 3023 AV51 uv_pairs=3,049,492,320 covering=0 read back from PR 3023's pinned receipts; PR 3034's m=5 ground-truth table incl. (5,5) cross=4,085,760 self=0 max_self_union=15/16). The walk machinery was validated on the smallest instances first (test_engine.py: solve engines equal complete brute force over all C(32,4) W 4-sets at m=5 and all W subsets at m=3; pair_backtrack42 equals brute force over all normalized V; the reduced lines equal direct A+D coverage on every halved F2^3 configuration; the residual symmetry of the reduced lines machine-checked). The (4,2) and (3,3) shapes were then completely enumerated at the smallest space (k=3 halves: 576 and 64 classes) where covers exist (positive ground truth: (2,2,4) has 80 covers, (3,3)-shape (3,3) has 296,352), so a false-empty is distinguishable from broken machinery, before the F2^5 walk was trusted at all.

open_questions.question: Complete the (12,6) A-vanish (4,2) walk (decide the class).
open_questions.why_it_matters: Clearing (4,2) forces any (12,6) A-vanish cover into (3,3); the kill shape observed on the first 249,244,455 pairs (w_candidates=0 everywhere) suggests the class may be empty, but a partial walk is never an exclusion.
open_questions.first_step: Resume run42.py av42 --shards 2048 from shard 29 with generous budgets (receipts are resumable and deterministic); the complete walk is sized at 1.722e10 pairs, ~608 core-hours at the measured rate, so shard widely (16-way) and merge.
open_questions.blocked_by: Compute only: no structural blocker. A structural proof would need the pair-level contradiction mechanism behind w_candidates=0 (not isolated here; the (5,1) counting shortcut is DEMOTED for (4,2)).

open_questions.question: Isolate the w_candidates=0 mechanism for (4,2) pairs (a structural kill-shape proof).
open_questions.why_it_matters: A pair-level contradiction (as for (5,1) over 3.05B pairs) would decide the class without the remaining ~605 core-hours of walk.
open_questions.first_step: Analyze the requirement system at |U+V| = 24 (|M| = 8: W independent with W u (W+1) = M exactly, at most 2^4 candidates) and prove or disprove that the 20+20 requirement points cannot be hit by those candidates.
open_questions.blocked_by: The (5,1) mechanism did not transfer by counting ((4,2)'s requirement/capacity window 20-21/24 is looser than (5,1)'s 26/30 with forced W); the observed kill is structural but not yet isolated.

open_questions.question: Decide or identify (12,6) A-vanish (3,3).
open_questions.why_it_matters: (3,3) is the last A-vanish class after (4,2).
open_questions.first_step: Either a new reduction (no singleton absorption exists) or a cross-line multiplicity identity coupling (I)/(II) with (III)/(IV); the complete k=3 shape census (this package) is the small ground truth (covers exist in the matched class, so no small-instance kill).
open_questions.blocked_by: All four line budgets are slack at (3,3); no forced structure (PR 3034's finding, confirmed here at k=3).

open_questions.question: Lift the even-half self-sum structure to the (11,7)/(9,9) frontier rows (PR 2961's open question 2).
open_questions.why_it_matters: The even-half direction is the one the PR 2870 odd-coverage squeeze did not use; (11,7)/(9,9) carry the other half of the 18-point question.
open_questions.first_step: Use the per-split constancy of mu2 = |(A+A) n (B+B)| (CHECKED at m=3 and m=4 in this package: every both-odd m=3 cover has the unique profile of its split, every m=4 both-even cover has constant mu2) as the candidate identity and derive its exact form at the 501/196 surviving rows (PR 2911) before lifting to m=6.
open_questions.blocked_by: The self-sum-size lift is DEMOTED (m=3 both-odd covers have full self-union 8/8 and full selfsums at (5,5)/(7,7)); no coupling identity between odd-line cross-sum multiplicities and even-line selfsums is known; mu2 constancy is CHECKED at two scales, not proven.

original_card.question: Can an explicitly larger or nonabelian register model escape the scoped three-register obstruction?
methods: Construct the smallest exact identity in a newly specified legal operation alphabet.
Derive a target-specific relaxation bound for that same explicit alphabet.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Name the changed hypothesis, all counted roles and a uniform identity; finite column tests alone do not certify it. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read Model section 1 of the three-register bound and identify the exact excluded free operations.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: First compare the alphabet, role count and length with the fully replayed #1974 census and #2027 mixed-root tariff. Identify a changed premise and a legal native implementation; then price one smallest completed instance before searching larger words.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A small-width completed saving changes the bit primitive; a finite-address identity alone is insufficient.
allowed_variations: Choose a fixed larger register count or a specified nonabelian operation family.
scope_change_triggers: Remaining inside the already-excluded three-register abelian model.
Repeating the two-register GL3 census or a covered three-register length without changing a hypothesis; a formal group-algebra word without native conversion is a partial result.
